notes.title: Welcome to PrivacyNotes
notes.body:
Every note you write is **end-to-end encrypted** with a key derived from your 12-word phrase. We can't read your notes. Not in transit, not at rest, not if our database got breached. That's math, not marketing.

**Your phrase is the only key.** Lose it and nothing recovers your notes. Write it down somewhere real.

![What our server actually sees: your notes as opaque, encrypted blobs.](/onboarding/database.webp)

*What our server sees: opaque ciphertext, encrypted on your device before it ever leaves.*

## Get going

- [ ] Create a note with **+ New Note**
- [ ] Try markdown: headings, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, lists, quotes (toolbar or just type)
- [ ] Link notes with `[[`, try [[Tasks: Getting started]] or [[Journal: First Day in Tokyo]]
- [ ] Tag a note with `#idea` or `#groceries` in the tag field
- [ ] **Star** a note to pin it to the top

## Vault

Store logins and credit cards, encrypted the same way as your notes. Check out the examples: [[Google]] and [[Visa ending 4242]].

## Import & Export

Sidebar → **Import / Export**. Bring in notes from Google Keep, Standard Notes, or markdown. Export as `.md`, `.html`, `.zip`, or `.json`. Your data is never trapped.

## Sync

Same 12-word phrase on another device and everything shows up, encrypted. No trackers, no ads, no telemetry.

notes.title: Tasks: Getting started
notes.body:
Tick these off as you go. Every `- [ ]` line across all your notes rolls up into the **Tasks** view in the sidebar. Scatter to-dos wherever they belong, see the full picture in one place.

- [ ] Write your first real note
- [ ] Tag it with `#idea` or `#todo` in the tag field
- [ ] **Star** a note to pin it to the top
- [ ] Open **search**, it searches content, not just titles
- [ ] Import old notes: sidebar → **Import / Export**
- [ ] Sign in on a second device with the same phrase
- [ ] Try **dark mode** and **zen mode**
- [ ] Open the **Vault** and check out the demo login and credit card

To start your own task list: toolbar → task list button, or just type `- [ ]` on a new line.

See [[Welcome to PrivacyNotes]] for the overview, or [[Journal: First Day in Tokyo]] for journal entries.

notes.title: Journal: Your Wellness Dashboard
notes.body:
The tracker pills above capture your day in a few taps: mood, sleep, activity, medication, energy, focus. Tap a pill to expand it, log a value, done. Everything encrypted.

**Emotion tags:** 24 research-backed options mapped to real psychology dimensions. Tap as many as apply.

**Medication tracking:** logs daily adherence. The "Multivitamin" is an example; edit it via the gear icon on the pill bar.

## Try these

- [ ] Tap the **Mood** pill and set it to how you actually feel
- [ ] Pick today's emotion tags
- [ ] Check **Statistics** (bar chart icon) → Wellness tab
- [ ] Tap the **gear icon** to configure which pills show up
- [ ] Backfill a past day via the **calendar icon** in journal view

After a week of logging, the Patterns tab starts detecting correlations: mood vs. sleep, medication adherence vs. energy. All computed locally.

---

*Delete this anytime. Your real journal starts with your first honest check-in.*

See [[Journal: First Day in Tokyo]] for a travel journal example.

notes.title: Journal: First Day in Tokyo
notes.body:
Landed at Narita around noon on three hours of plane sleep. The train into the city was the first thing that clicked. Silent carriage, punctual to the second, a vending machine selling hot coffee in a can.

![Tokyo skyline at dusk, Shibuya crossing lit up in neon.](/onboarding/japan.webp)

## Things to do:

- [ ] Meiji Shrine (Harajuku station)
- [ ] Tsukiji Outer Market
- [ ] Wander Shinjuku at night
- [ ] Shibuya Crossing and Shibuya Sky

Ended up in a six-seat ramen place where the only English was a QR code on the wall. Pointed at a photo, got a tsukemen that made me forget about jet lag for twenty minutes.

## Tomorrow

- Teamlab Planets, book before breakfast
- Find the jazz bar in Golden Gai
- Try a konbini egg sandwich

Crossed Shibuya at rush hour. Seen it a thousand times in photos and it still doesn't prepare you. The sheer *choreography* of it. Nobody bumps into anyone.

---

*This is an example journal entry. Create new entries from the Journal view. Daily entries, writing streaks, the works.*

See [[Journal: Your Wellness Dashboard]] for wellness tracking, or [[Tasks: Getting started]] for a checklist.
